market: Europe Heat-Activated Adhesive Films and Webs Market
market_definition: The heat-activated adhesive films and webs market comprises thermoplastic, solid adhesive layers activated by heat and pressure to laminate or bond materials. It measures sales of films, webs, nets and powders for textile, footwear and light-industrial bonding. BY POLYMER TYPE: Polyurethane (TPU), Copolyester, Copolyamide, Polyolefin / EVA. BY PRODUCT FORM: Continuous Film, Nonwoven Web, Mesh / Net, Pressure-Applied Powder. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Textiles & Apparel, Footwear, Automotive Interiors, Filtration & Nonwovens, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Structural adhesive films for composites; PSA transfer tapes; hot melt adhesives applied from the melt; textile fabrics and nonwovens. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
